title: Auto Totem+
description: A great way to dominate in Minecraft pvp, especially with crystals!
body:
# Auto Totem

Auto Totem is a lightweight, client-side mod that automatically moves Totems of Undying from your inventory to your offhand, ensuring you are always protected from lethal damage.

## Key Features

*   **Automatic Equipping:** Instantly moves a totem to your offhand whenever the slot is empty or does not contain a totem. 
*   **Toggle Keybind:** Press **R** to quickly enable or disable the mod when you need manual control.
*   **Performance Optimized:** Features a configurable tick delay to balance responsiveness with game performance.
*   **Easy Configuration:** Full integration with Mod Menu and Cloth Config (on versions after 15th may 2026, a custom screen was implemented) for seamless in-game adjustments.
*   **Client-Side:** Works on any server—no server-side installation required.

## Perfect For

*   Hardcore mode and survival gameplay
*   High-stakes PvP combat
*   Challenging modpacks
*   Exploring dangerous dimensions

## Requirements

### Fabric
*   Fabric API
*   Cloth Config
*   Mod Menu (Optional, required for the config GUI)

## Configuration Options

*   **Enabled:** Toggle the auto-equipping functionality on or off.
*   **Tick Delay:** Adjust the responsiveness (0–20 ticks) to fit your performance needs.

---

> ### ⚠️ Multiplayer Disclaimer
> This mod introduces automation features. While it functions on any server, some multiplayer networks consider inventory automation to be an unfair advantage. 
> 
> **Use at your own risk.** Please review individual server rules before using this mod in multiplayer, as the developer is not responsible for any resulting bans.
